# AI · reliability & quality

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Hallucinations
- What: When an AI model states something false with confidence.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept

### Output guardrails
- What: Check the AI's answer before acting on it or showing it as fact.
- Applies when: AI output triggers actions or is shown as fact.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: AI output is checked before it is acted on, and an answer outside the allowed bounds is blocked.

### Evals
- What: A set of test questions with known good answers, run to measure an AI feature's quality.
- Applies when: an AI feature is central to the app.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Each prompt has a small set of example inputs with facts the answer must contain, run as a test.

### LLM-as-judge
- What: Use one AI model to grade another's answers at volume.
- Applies when: AI output quality must be graded at volume.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### A/B testing
- What: Show two versions to different users and measure which works better.
- Applies when: there is enough traffic to compare two versions.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: practice

### LLM tracing
- What: Record each AI call with its input, output, time and cost, to debug and improve it.
- Applies when: AI features run under real use.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable
